nodes.name: Daily 06:15
nodes.notes: Proactive dead-man's-switch for Fable 5 access (ADR-037). Catches the 2026-06-23 credit cliff and any other outage BEFORE a 'Krytycznie ważne' task hits it. The reactive layer (Execute LLM Call -> Alert Invoke Model Failed) only fires AFTER a task already failed.

nodes.name: Check now (manual)
nodes.notes: Manual harness to run the probe on demand (Schedule Trigger can't be fired via API).

parameters.formDescription: Press submit to probe Fable 5 via the LiteLLM gateway now.

nodes.name: Probe Fable
nodes.notes: 1-token call to haxe-fable-5-direct through the gateway. Non-2xx (e.g. 4xx credit-exhausted after 2026-06-23, or unknown-model) -> node error -> error output -> CRITICAL alert. retryOnFail damps transient blips so we don't cry wolf.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'haxe-fable-5-direct', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'ping' }], max_tokens: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: Alert Fable Down
nodes.notes: CRITICAL: Fable unreachable means 'Krytycznie ważne' (non-PD) tasks are failing. Remediation in details: top up Anthropic credits OR roll routing back to Opus 4.8 (read live, no restart needed).

value.message: Model Fable 5 (haxe-fable-5-direct) jest niedostępny przez bramę LiteLLM — zadania 'Krytycznie ważne' (bez danych osobowych) zawodzą.
